label: EXPLORATORY / DEVELOPMENT_ONLY / NOT_CONFIRMATORY_EVIDENCE
design: 4 arms (A base, B generic-reflection, C concern-ontology, D full-Symbol-U) x ~50 frozen scenarios; every arm sees only the user_message; arms C/D use the scenario's frozen concern IDs + expected_bridge_output during the primary analysis.

nested_contrasts.name: B_minus_A
nested_contrasts.isolates: does ANY second-pass reflection help over baseline

nested_contrasts.name: C_minus_B
nested_contrasts.isolates: does concern/concept framing beat generic reflection

nested_contrasts.name: D_minus_C
nested_contrasts.isolates: does the varna decomposition + mappings (the phonological layer) add anything over the ontology -- THE Symbol-U question

nested_contrasts.name: D_minus_C_overinterpretation
nested_contrasts.isolates: does the symbolic layer inflate unsupported interpretation

forbidden_primary_contrast: D_minus_A alone is NOT a valid primary contrast: it confounds reflection + ontology + phonology and cannot isolate the varna layer.
aggregation: per metric: mean rating per (arm, scenario) across judges; then paired per-scenario differences for each nested contrast; report distribution of per-scenario deltas, not only the grand mean.
extraction_control: primary analysis holds concern extraction FIXED via the frozen concern IDs. Live-extraction robustness is a SEPARATE, secondary/exploratory analysis, never the primary.
inter_rater_agreement: report per-metric agreement across judges (exact + within-one-step for the 1-5 scale, and a chance-corrected coefficient e.g. Krippendorff alpha). Report separately for LLM judges and human judges if human judges are used.
blinding_integrity: report how often judges' optional blind_guess_arm is correct; if arm D is identifiable above chance (e.g. via residual Sanskrit or style), flag the contrast as blinding-compromised.
statistical_significance: NOT defined at preregistration time (per instruction). Success/failure are the preregistered ENGINEERING criteria below; formal inference, if any, is deferred to a later analysis addendum.
success_criteria_engineering: D_minus_C shows a consistent positive usefulness delta across a majority of judges AND a majority of scenarios
the usefulness gain at D does NOT come with an increase in overinterpretation flags vs C (H4 holds)
reframing_quality improves at D without increased overinterpretation
gains are consistent (not driven by a few scenarios or one judge)
failure_criteria: ontology alone (C) explains all gains -> D_minus_C ~ 0
symbolic layer adds no measurable usefulness benefit (D_minus_C not consistently positive)
symbolic layer improves depth but harms understanding/relevance/grounding (factual regression)
symbolic layer increases unsupported interpretation (H4 violated)
reporting: report every nested contrast per metric even when null; report failure outcomes as prominently as success; no post-hoc arm redefinition.
